        function reusableInitialParagraph() {
            const paragraphs = document.getParagraphs();
            const initialParagraph = paragraphs[0];
            if (paragraphs.length !== 1 ||
                !initialParagraph ||
                initialParagraph.getText().length !== 0 ||
                document.getSections().length !== 1) {
                return undefined;
            }
            const range = initialParagraph.getRange();
            return range.startOffset === 0 && range.endOffset === 0 ? initialParagraph : undefined;
        }
        function removeUnusedInitialParagraph(initialParagraph) {
            if (initialParagraph &&
                initialParagraph.getText().length === 0 &&
                document.getParagraphs().length > 1) {
                initialParagraph.remove();
            }
        }
        function paragraphVisibleTextAffixes(paragraphText, expectedText) {
            if (expectedText.length === 0) {
                return paragraphText.length === 0 ? { prefix: "", suffix: "" } : undefined;
            }
            const visibleIndex = paragraphText.indexOf(expectedText);
            if (visibleIndex < 0 || paragraphText.indexOf(expectedText, visibleIndex + 1) >= 0) {
                return undefined;
            }
            const prefix = paragraphText.slice(0, visibleIndex);
            const suffix = paragraphText.slice(visibleIndex + expectedText.length);
            // Facade paragraph ranges inside sections, column groups, and callouts can include
            // non-visible document-tree tokens around their visible text. Accept only known structural
            // tokens; an arbitrary control character must still fail closed instead of shifting ranges.
            const isStructural = (value) => value.length === 0 || /^[\v\f\n\u0010-\u0015]+$/u.test(value);
            return isStructural(prefix) && isStructural(suffix) ? { prefix, suffix } : undefined;
        }
        function paragraphInsertedAt(insertOffset, expectedText) {
            const paragraph = document.getParagraphs().find((candidate) => {
                const range = candidate.getRange();
                const text = candidate.getText();
                const affixes = paragraphVisibleTextAffixes(text, expectedText);
                return affixes !== undefined &&
                    range.startOffset + affixes.prefix.length === insertOffset &&
                    range.endOffset - affixes.suffix.length === insertOffset + expectedText.length;
            });
            if (!paragraph) {
                const candidates = document.getParagraphs().map((candidate) => ({
                    range: candidate.getRange(),
                    text: candidate.getText()
                }));
                throw new Error("Generated paragraph was not inserted at the requested section-local offset " +
                    insertOffset +
                    ": " +
                    JSON.stringify(candidates) +
                    ".");
            }
            return paragraph;
        }
        function appendStyledParagraph(text, style) {
            const initialParagraph = reusableInitialParagraph();
            let paragraph;
            if (initialParagraph) {
                paragraph = initialParagraph;
                paragraph.setText(text);
            }
            else {
                const insertOffset = documentBodyEndOffset();
                if (!document.insertText(insertOffset, text + "\r")) {
                    throw new Error("Generated paragraph could not be inserted at the end of its section.");
                }
                paragraph = paragraphInsertedAt(insertOffset, text);
            }
            if (style !== undefined && Object.keys(style).length > 0) {
                paragraph.setStyle(style);
            }
            return paragraph;
        }
        function replaceStyledSegmentParagraph(text, style, segmentId) {
            const inheritedParagraphs = document.getParagraphs(segmentId);
            const paragraph = document.appendParagraph("", segmentId);
            for (const inheritedParagraph of [...inheritedParagraphs].reverse()) {
                if (!inheritedParagraph.remove()) {
                    throw new Error("Generated Doc header/footer inherited paragraph could not be removed.");
                }
            }
            paragraph.setText(text);
            if (style !== undefined && Object.keys(style).length > 0) {
                paragraph.setStyle(style);
            }
            return paragraph;
        }
        function appendStyledMarkdownParagraph(markdown, expectedText, style) {
            const initialParagraph = reusableInitialParagraph();
            const insertOffset = documentBodyEndOffset();
            const fragment = univerAPI.convertMarkdown(markdown);
            if (!document.replaceRange({ startOffset: insertOffset, endOffset: insertOffset }, fragment)) {
                throw new Error("Generated Markdown paragraph could not be inserted at the end of its section.");
            }
            const paragraph = paragraphInsertedAt(insertOffset, expectedText);
            removeUnusedInitialParagraph(initialParagraph);
            if (style !== undefined && Object.keys(style).length > 0) {
                paragraph.setStyle(style);
            }
            return paragraph;
        }
        function applyParagraphTextRuns(paragraph, expectedText, runs) {
            const paragraphText = paragraph.getText();
            const affixes = paragraphVisibleTextAffixes(paragraphText, expectedText);
            if (affixes === undefined) {
                throw new Error("Generated paragraph visible text changed before applying text runs: expected " +
                    JSON.stringify(expectedText) +
                    ", received " +
                    JSON.stringify(paragraphText) +
                    ".");
            }
            const paragraphRange = paragraph.getRange();
            const visibleStartOffset = paragraphRange.startOffset + affixes.prefix.length;
            for (const run of runs) {
                document
                    .getTextRange(visibleStartOffset + run.startOffset, visibleStartOffset + run.endOffset, paragraph.getSegmentId())
                    .setTextStyle(run.style);
            }
        }
        function documentBodyEndOffset() {
            const finalSection = document.getSections().at(-1);
            if (!finalSection) {
                throw new Error("Generated traditional document has no final section.");
            }
            return finalSection.getRange().endOffset;
        }
        function compactGeneratedTableTailParagraph(table) {
            const tableRange = table.getRange();
            if (!tableRange) {
                return;
            }
            const tailParagraph = document.getParagraphs().find((paragraph) => {
                const range = paragraph.getRange();
                return paragraph.getText().length === 0 &&
                    range.startOffset === tableRange.endOffset &&
                    range.endOffset === tableRange.endOffset;
            });
            tailParagraph?.setStyle({
                lineSpacing: 1,
                snapToGrid: 0,
                spacingRule: 2,
                spaceAbove: { v: 0 },
                spaceBelow: { v: 0 },
                textStyle: { fs: 1 }
            });
        }
        function isDefaultBackground(color) {
            return color.toUpperCase() === "#FFFFFF" || color.toLowerCase() === "white";
        }
        function tableCellRangesByBackground(cells) {
            const rows = new Map();
            for (const cell of cells) {
                if (cell.background === undefined || isDefaultBackground(cell.background)) {
                    continue;
                }
                const row = rows.get(cell.row) ?? [];
                row.push({ color: cell.background, column: cell.column });
                rows.set(cell.row, row);
            }
            const ranges = [];
            for (const [rowIndex, rowCells] of rows) {
                const sorted = rowCells.sort((left, right) => left.column - right.column);
                let active;
                for (const cell of sorted) {
                    if (active !== undefined &&
                        active.color === cell.color &&
                        active.endColumn + 1 === cell.column) {
                        active.endColumn = cell.column;
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (active !== undefined) {
                        ranges.push({
                            color: active.color,
                            range: {
                                endColumn: active.endColumn,
                                endRow: rowIndex,
                                startColumn: active.startColumn,
                                startRow: rowIndex
                            }
                        });
                    }
                    active = { color: cell.color, startColumn: cell.column, endColumn: cell.column };
                }
                if (active !== undefined) {
                    ranges.push({
                        color: active.color,
                        range: {
                            endColumn: active.endColumn,
                            endRow: rowIndex,
                            startColumn: active.startColumn,
                            startRow: rowIndex
                        }
                    });
                }
            }
            return ranges;
        }
        function applyTableCellParagraphStyle(table, row, column, style) {
            const contentRange = table.getCellContentRange(row, column);
            if (!contentRange) {
                return;

        function applyTableCellTextRuns(table, row, column, expectedText, runs) {

                throw new Error("Generated table-cell visible text does not match its semantic source.");

            }
        }
        function applyTableCellLines(table, row, column, lines) {
            if (lines.length === 0) {
                return;

            const contentRange = table.getCellContentRange(row, column);
            if (!contentRange) {
                return;

                const range = paragraph.getRange();
                return range.endOffset > contentRange.startOffset && range.startOffset < contentRange.endOffset;

                if (line.style === undefined || Object.keys(line.style).length === 0) {

            }
        }
